adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces `Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` and in `Post#cook` returns `raw` verbatim when that cook_method is set (app/models/post.rb). `Jobs::PollFeed` parses feed items and passes `CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` directly into `TopicEmbed.import` without any sanitization (app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb), and `TopicEmbed.import` creates posts with `cook_method: :raw_html` (app/models/topic_embed.rb). The embed view renders `raw post.cooked` (app/views/embed/best.html.erb), so any `<script>`/event-handler HTML in the feed can be stored and served as-is, creating a verifiable XSS vector. The note about missing spec is secondary, but the underlying unsanitized bypass is a real security defect exposed by this diff.
